title: The Doppelganger
text: At dawn there is one Scion too many in camp. Two of them sit by the fire, the same face, the same scars, the same way of holding a cup. Both of them swear they are the real one. Both of them are frightened, or both of them are very good at it.

options.label: The sharpest asks them both what only the real one could know.

outcomes.text: The false one fumbles a childhood name, and its face slips, and it runs. Nobody sleeps near the fire that night.
Both answer perfectly. Both of them smile, in exactly the same way.

options.label: Keep both close until one gives itself away, and never turn your back.

outcomes.text: It gives itself away at the worst possible moment, with a knife, and the face it wears is still the one you trusted.

options.label: Test them both with silver, and see whose skin can bear it.

outcomes.text: Silver burns one of them, and it stops pretending, and what it is underneath is not a person.
